page.layout: One page of text, with the chapter heading and title above the first section. Page number at the top centre. No running head. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the lower left. Faint show-through in the margins is ignored.

main_text.head: CAP. XX. Decimum tertium nostrum Argumentum adversus Meritum de Condigno, ex parte profectus verae pietatis.
Argumentatio.
SECT. I.
main_text.p: Professio, quae minus valet ad verae pietatis profectum, est minus probanda: Sed profes-sio Meriti de Condigno minus valet ad verae pietatis profectum, quam contraria Protestantium: Idcirco est minus probanda.
Major est magis manifesta, quam quae ab Adversariis negari possit: Minorem dis-sertatio sequens, Deo duce, abunde demon-strabit.
Tria sunt quae ad profectum verae pieta-tis requiri possunt; Necessitas, Dignitas, & Veritas bonorum operum.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout, and "eft" written as "est" as instructed. The printed "ft" ligature in "demonstrabit" read as "st". The large initial P is joined to "Professio". The italic "Veritas" has a mark above it that may be a decorative initial; read as V. No marginal notes. Faint show-through text in the margins was excluded.
